overallSummary: Fabio Giglietto maintains a highly active and influential professional presence across academic and decentralized social networks, capturing a combined audience of 3,580 followers. Content focusing on actionable academic updates, tool releases, and career opportunities drives strong community amplification, resulting in highly competitive engagement rates across all analyzed channels.

contentThemes.description: Announcements showcasing published papers and updates to software tools such as CooRnet.
Callouts for open academic positions, postdocs, and PhD opportunities within computational social science.
Discussion of industry events, conferences, and methodologies for analyzing coordinated platform behavior.

recommendations: Leverage Bluesky's highly receptive audience by prioritizing it for early drafts and collaborative research calls.
Include rich media such as screenshots of CooRnet dashboards or diagrams of study designs to boost visual interest on LinkedIn.
Foster deeper community discussion on Mastodon and Bluesky by asking open-ended research questions to increase comment volume.

platformInsights.bluesky: Acts as the most engaging platform with an average engagement rate of 6.14%, showing high virality and repost actions on research sharing and study opportunities.
platformInsights.mastodon: Provides strong niche targeting for technical developments, yielding a stable 4.55% engagement rate and highly relevant peer-to-peer amplification.
platformInsights.linkedin: Generates the highest absolute volume of engagement and comments, making it the ideal channel for official announcements like grant awards and recruitment drives.
